_meta.purpose: The material index — the resolved 'blend-results' a voxel renders. A material is NOT an element; it is what an aggregate element-composition (periodic_table.json) CLASSIFIES to from a voxel's perspective. Index space is 0-255; only a limited RESOLVED set is defined now — the rest is reserved to grow.
_meta.classify: A voxel's material = the classifier's pick over its ledger (flicker-worldstate::classify_material, P2 of the materials-unification plan, 2026-08-19). Primary key: the DOMINANT COMPOUND by mass resolves through `represents`; fallback: best-match of the element composition against `signature` (full signature present, most-specific wins, lower id breaks ties). Derived, never stored as truth — recompute after any ledger change.
_meta.represents: Compound NAMES (exact, from the merged compound catalog — same scheme as rocks.json modal keys) whose dominance classifies a container to THIS material. Resolved + uniqueness-gated at load: an unknown name or two materials claiming one compound refuses to load. Rows without `represents` are reachable only via the signature fallback (Bedrock/Basalt/Shale/Gravel = generic rock ground). Ice and Lava carry none ON PURPOSE: same compounds as Water/rock under different CONDITIONS (T/P) — the v2 conditions hook of the R7 registry decides those, never composition alone.
_meta.render_class: REQUIRED on every row except the id-0 Air placeholder (never drawn). The closed 4-way render axis (Aaron, ratified 2026-08-19, amending the 2026-08-18 3-way): 'blendable' = top-surface terrain, participates in voxel primary/secondary/blend transitions; 'hard_edge' = rocks/ores/minerals, renders as itself, NEVER blended (blend forced 0 at mesh build) — the visual signature is player-facing information; 'translucent' = gems/ice/water/oil, the alpha/refraction path; 'emissive' = glowing, colours restricted to the curated palettes.json emissive set. Orthogonal to `category` (geological identity, free-form) — never merge the two.
_meta.reserved_ids: 248-255: the 8-slot exotic-emissive insurance block (Aaron, ruled 2026-08-19 — ghost/exotic effects are shader-driven first; these slots exist in case shader-only proves insufficient). No material may be defined in this range until Aaron releases it.
_meta.traits: hardness (Mohs-like 0-10, erosion resistance), brittleness (0 ductile..1 shatters → sediment), water_capacity (0..1 porosity / how much water it holds), viscosity (0 flows freely each pass .. 1 static solid; governs how a flow-effect material moves per pass — water lowest, oil/lava mid, ice creeps high), density_g_cm3 (differentiation / weight). Authoritative here; element traits are the blend fallback. PROPOSED STARTING VALUES — tune.
_meta.render: color [r,g,b] 0-1 is a placeholder palette; the P1 palette-buffer wiring (materials-unification plan) replaces the mesh.wgsl demo palette with these colours, until Sablework-defined textures land per slot.
_meta.effects_note: water / ice / lava are not stacked layers — they are tracked effects (persistent saturation/flow state) whose per-pass motion rate comes from viscosity. Water and Lava KEEP their material slots (Aaron, ruled 2026-08-19): the classifier needs an answer for a mostly-water/molten container; the fancy liquid rendering is a shader pass keyed off the slot, not a replacement for it.
